snippet.title: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim｜Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...
SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim  is now available on Steam, DLsite, and Stove.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492120/SAEKO_Giantess_Dating_Sim/

SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the lives of Saeko, a girl with mysterious abilities, 
and the little people she has shrunk to the size of her thumb. 
Experience Saeko's and the little people's fates in the day and at night, through two separate game systems with different art styles.

You are Rin, the latest addition to the little people. Under Saeko’s protection, you spend your days in her desk drawer together with the other little people.
But don't let your guard down. Saeko has some...interesting hobbies, to say the least.


Genre：                ADV
Price：　　　　 $14.99
Developer：        SAFE HAVN STUDIO
Publisher：         HYPER REAL
Platform：          PC（Steam・DLsite・Stove）
Language：        Japanese・English・Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)
　　　　　　　  *Korean supported only on Stove version
